comments.author: @robinprobyn1971
comments.text: VAT is an indirect tax , basically its the government sort of hiding another form of taxation , the companies that charge it are just the middle men ( Tax collectors !) , they can also claim back VAT they have to pay for goods , so they can be tax neutral , but the ultimate payer is of course the consumer or anyone no VAT registered  .  VAT will always go up , and more companies and individuals pushed into be VAT registered . UK for most goods is now 20% , in Japan it was 5% then 8% and now 10% , better get used to it unfortunately.  The US now has Trumps tariffs on a lot of imports , which I believe a lot of Americans don't understand , is not paid by the exporting country , as Trump would have them believe, but by the US importer , who, drum roll, passes it onto the consumer , so actually US citizens are the ones paying the tariff not the exporting country !
